Reduction of K for k^2=1/2 to a beta integral expressed with Gauss Pi functions
Reflection formula for the Pi (Gamma) function
Closed form of the lemniscatic K in terms of Pi(1/4)
Logarithmic numerical computation of omega = K at k^2=1/2
Legendre-relation consequence for derivative of log K' at k^2=1/2
Logarithmic differentiation of expressions in K, K', k, k'
